completion_exclusions: Staging, committing, pushing, pull-request creation, merging, synchronization, or cleanup without separate publication authority
GitHub write operations or repository administration
Spending, deployment, or public or LAN exposure
Destructive operations, force-push, or history rewrite
Phase 0 graduation execution or completion claim
permitted_actions: Edit and verify the exact allowed paths
Run read-only Git and GitHub CLI evidence commands
Render and inspect the exact DOCX companion
Repair implementation or test failures inside the allowed paths

Retain unbounded or unredacted provider logs

Remove or weaken an existing IRIS or Codex capability

Red-green regression evidence for Core behavior and personal delegation

Live read-only preflight evidence for both repositories

Publication state reported separately from local implementation state
